summary: Knowledge backend sync trigger (ai-sdlc-enterprise RFC-0002 OQ-J, N1-N3): optional sync()/status(), cli-context sync/status, and when hooks run sync

options.description: N1+N2, hook runs detached sync at session start only, only when the backend has sync(), at most once per interval; session-start line prints queued/rejected counts plus last sync error
N1+N2, hook runs sync at session start and every stop (as asked)
Decline; backend refreshes its replica itself

body: DEC-0430 b fixed the sync contract (sync writes the replica list() reads, then rebuildIndex; full rebuild). Open: the trigger. Enterprise asked: optional sync()/status() on the backend (files may omit), cli-context sync and status, and plugin session hooks starting sync detached at session start and each stop, at most once per interval, printing queued/rejected counts at session start. Rebuild cost with an API embedder is unmeasured (290 ms / 501 entries with the local embedder, enterprise figure).
